recognize_zh: 兩顆相鄰的分葉嗜中性球，左邊那顆外圍被一整圈血小板緊密包圍，右邊那顆邊緣也有數顆血小板貼附；血小板黏在嗜中性球膜外形成花環狀，是典型血小板衛星現象。
features: Two adjacent mature segmented neutrophils with fine cytoplasmic granules
Left neutrophil encircled by a dense ring of adherent platelets; right neutrophil with fewer adherent platelets
Adherent platelets are normal in size and granularity
Occasional free platelets in the background
Red cells with occasional crenated forms and refractile drying artifact
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows two mature segmented neutrophils. The left neutrophil is surrounded by a nearly complete rosette of adherent platelets, and the right neutrophil has several platelets attached to its margin. The platelets are extracellular, of normal size, and not phagocytosed. Findings are consistent with platelet satellitism, an EDTA-dependent in vitro phenomenon that may produce pseudothrombocytopenia.

ddx.vs: Phagocytosed platelets lie within cytoplasmic vacuoles inside the neutrophil, whereas here they sit on the outer membrane.
Platelet clumps are free-floating platelet aggregates not organized around leukocytes.

ddx.dx: Gray platelet syndrome or giant platelets
ddx.vs: These are intrinsic platelet abnormalities with pale or large platelets, while the platelets here are normal and only their distribution is abnormal.
